look.name: Neon Halo
look.description: A vivid purple-blue editorial eye look with sculpted skin, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, neutral medium
steps.tip: Sheer the foundation from the center of your face outward with a damp sponge, then lightly press around the nose and forehead for an even canvas. Keep the layer thin so the eye color stays the focus.

product.name: Pro Filt'r Soft Matte Longwear Foundation

steps.title: Concealer, light neutral
steps.tip: Tap this under the eyes in a soft triangle and over any dark circles or puffy areas, then blend the edges upward. Add a tiny touch on visible spots and age spots only where you need extra coverage.

steps.title: Brows, soft natural arch
steps.tip: Fill your brows with short hairlike strokes, keeping the arch soft and the front feathered. Brush through with a spoolie so they stay full but not blocky.

steps.title: Eyes, editorial halo
steps.tip: Pack the light blue on the inner lid, place the violet across the lid, and deepen the outer ring with the blue so it frames the eye. Blend the magenta slightly above the crease and keep a bright inner corner so the shape reads open and lifted.

steps.title: Liner and lashes, lifted outer corners
steps.tip: Draw a slim wing that follows the outer eye angle and keeps the lift at the end, not the center. Then add mascara or lashes that fan upward on the outer corners to match the sharp editorial shape.

steps.title: Cheeks, soft bronze
steps.tip: Sweep bronzer lightly over the temples, outer forehead, and just under the cheekbones for warmth. Use what is left on the brush around the nose and jaw so the skin stays sculpted, not heavy.

steps.title: Lips, muted nude
steps.tip: Line and fill the lips with a rosy nude close to your natural tone, then soften the edges for that blurred editorial finish. Keep the center just a touch fuller for balance against the strong eyes.
